sources.note: Nothing on stress. Reproduces the entire attested corpus, an 8-word list (bueno esumatá, malo emayio, padre tatá, madre naná, hermano nochoine, uno eapurava, dos casevava, tres quimisa), citing Palau & Saiz 1989: 169. The acute accents are the 1794 Spanish scribe's orthography, not a published stress statement.
